title: Clinical intelligence, grounded in evidence.
desc: RAG services, LangGraph orchestration, clinical integrations, and AWS deployment.
problem: Clinical evidence was fragmented across EHR systems and claims. Coding support needed grounded context and controlled workflow execution.
contribution: Developed retrieval and agent services; partnered with clinical, platform, and compliance teams on evaluation and production readiness.
choices: Grounding before generation
Use chunking, metadata filtering, hybrid retrieval, and reranking to assemble relevant clinical context.
Retrieval adds latency and requires its own relevance evaluation; a fluent answer alone is not evidence of correctness.
Controlled agent execution
Use explicit workflow state, routing, and tool interfaces for multi-step clinical and compliance tasks.
More autonomy increases the importance of tool permissions, validation, error handling, and observable handoffs.
Evaluation as a release gate
Compare prompt, model, retrieval, and orchestration changes against golden datasets and human review.
Offline metrics provide repeatability; expert review is still needed to assess workflow usefulness.
checks: Latency, token consumption, and regression comparisons
delivery: Docker, Amazon EKS, Terraform, and Argo CD supported deployment. LangSmith, LangFuse, Datadog, and CloudWatch supported tracing, quality monitoring, and issue investigation.
ownership: RAG services, LangGraph orchestration, clinical integrations, and AWS deployment.

title: Financial knowledge. Production discipline.
desc: Reusable retrieval components, response validation, and Azure production integration.
problem: Financial knowledge services needed consistent retrieval, validated responses, and reliable production delivery.
contribution: Developed Python and LangChain services for retrieval, inference, and validation; integrated them with Azure infrastructure.
choices: Reusable orchestration
Separate retrieval, context assembly, inference, and response validation into modular services.
Clear interfaces improve maintainability but require integration tests across the full workflow.
Context and throughput
Tune retrieval, chunk sizes, context management, semantic caching, and token controls.
Performance improvements must be checked against grounding and response consistency.
Resilient deployment
Package services in Docker and deploy through ACR and AKS with health checks, replicas, and autoscaling.
Runtime availability does not prove answer quality; both operational and semantic monitoring are needed.
checks: A/B comparisons of prompt and retrieval configurations
API validation, integration tests, and regression testing
delivery: GitHub Actions and Terraform supported repeatable delivery. Azure Monitor, Application Insights, Datadog, and distributed tracing supported production observability.
ownership: Reusable retrieval components, response validation, and Azure production integration.

title: Help people find what they came for.
desc: Hybrid retrieval, behavioral features, and scalable ranking pipelines.
problem: Low search relevance increased customer friction and support escalations.
contribution: Developed lexical and embedding retrieval, ranking features, and Spark/Airflow pipelines; partnered with product teams on evaluation.
choices: Hybrid candidate retrieval
Combine BM25 lexical matching with embedding-based similarity and behavioral signals.
Exact terms and semantic intent contribute different signals; candidate recall and ranking quality need separate checks.
Scalable feature pipelines
Use Spark and Airflow to prepare and enrich data for search and recommendation workflows.
Feature freshness and data quality affect the reliability of downstream ranking.
Measure relevance and impact
Use Recall@K, MRR, offline evaluation, and A/B testing to guide ranking changes.
Offline ranking gains should be checked against actual query resolution and customer outcomes.
delivery: Supported production ML and data pipelines using Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD workflows, and AWS infrastructure.
ownership: Hybrid retrieval, behavioral features, and scalable ranking pipelines.
